caveats: Requires Paseo 0.9.2 or newer on every daemon that shares notes
Notes sync between daemons only while the Paseo app is open
An agent keeps the notes it was created with; only new agents see an edit
Notes go into the prompts of agents on every daemon, so install it only on daemons you trust
Deleting a notes file does not delete it on other daemons; empty the file instead
A folder with no origin remote gets no notes
